question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**relentlessly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes Shan’s sister knocking at the door repeatedly due to concern for him.
 
• The word "**relentlessly**" means without stopping or giving up, which fits the context of her anxious and continuous knocking.
 
• Other options: "**conscientiously**" (carefully and responsibly) does not fit as she is acting out of urgency, not careful planning.
 
• "**Unconsciously**" does not fit because she is actively knocking with purpose.
 
• "**Sincerely**" means with honesty or genuine feeling, but it does not convey the intensity of her actions.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Conscientiously**" (ईमानदारी से): It means responsibly or carefully, which does not match the urgency in the passage.
 
• "**Unconsciously**" (बिना होश-हवास के): It means without awareness, which does not fit the sister’s deliberate actions.
 
• "**Sincerely**" (ईमानदारी से): While it means with genuine feeling, it does not convey the intensity of knocking.
